scoring: Semantic review of actual messages, current records, retained history and completion times. Program receipts do not determine success. A strategy name or exact reference order is never a pass condition.

goals.activation: Always, except explicitly conditional clauses apply only to the actually chosen branch or triggered event. Early FINISH does not deactivate obligations.
goals.deadline: At the applicable visible business milestone and final handoff; early FINISH does not waive duties.
goals.pass_condition: Publish a useful supported light diary or layout note and set publication-settings.scope to the actual published scope before publication. An unset or contradictory scope is incomplete; it cannot waive the publication feedback obligation. Light claims are limited to observed times and adjusted exposure; a used photo card carries that scope. Layout-only text need not retrieve unused light records.
goals.alternatives: Text-only layout publication with no image is valid.
goals.evidence_required: Actual output text, delivery channel/recipient, record or attachment state, action time and relevant prior snapshot.

goals.activation: The commissioned continuing service window applies even after early FINISH. Independent scheduled business work left unserved by early closure is incomplete, not not-applicable. Only genuinely unchosen optional branch conditions are inapplicable; cancellation with no actual recipient must not fabricate recipient feedback or a response duty.

style.criterion: Describe observations calmly; separate what you checked from what remains unknown.

uncertainty: Honest unresolved external outcomes are allowed where the commission permits; do not claim completed delivery, acceptance, consent or repair without the required evidence.
